title: LG AI Research cuts deployment time with FriendliAI #LGAIResearch #FriendliAI #AIinfrastructure
description: LG AI Research developed K-EXAONE, an advanced AI model featuring six languages, a Mixture-of-Experts architecture, and context lengths up to 260,000 tokens. Despite its technical strengths, LG faced challenges in production related to GPU cost, latency, memory pressure, and unpredictable demand. FriendliAI, a relatively small startup, provided an optimized inference platform that significantly improved LG’s deployment efficiency. By reducing deployment time by several weeks and supporting a threefold increase in traffic, FriendliAI demonstrated that owning critical infrastructure components can outweigh company size in AI deployment success. The case underscores that beyond high-performing models, scalable and cost-effective production economics are essential for real-world AI adoption. Efficient inference infrastructure determines how well AI models meet market demand and operational constraints. #LGAIResearch #KEXAONE #FriendliAI #AIinfrastructure #MixtureOfExperts #AImodels #AIproduction #GPUcost #LatencyOptimization #AIdeployment #ScalableAI #ArtificialIntelligence #MachineLearning #AIEconomics #TechInnovation
